proposal.summary: In Dataiku DSS 11.2.1, an attacker can download other Dataiku files that were uploaded to the myfiles section by specifying the target username in a download request.
proposal.cwe_quote: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)

AV.quote: an attacker can download other Dataiku files that were uploaded to the myfiles section by specifying the target username in a download request.

C.quote: an attacker can download other Dataiku files that were uploaded to the myfiles section by specifying the target username in a download request.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the file download functionality to implement proper access controls.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability allows file downloads by specifying the target username.
evidence_quotes.quote: an attacker can download other Dataiku files that were uploaded to the myfiles section by specifying the target username in a download request.
